name: Puerto Vallarta
blurb: Puerto Vallarta draws travelers for its coastal setting where the Pacific meets the Sierra Madre Occidental, offering art galleries, nightlife, and culinary options. Online discussions note recent local developments including city council revenue bills and ongoing wildlife management issues.

positive: Vibrant art scene, street art, and live music
Appreciated coastal sunsets and warm weather
Diverse dining, craft beer, and nightlife venues
negative: Concerns over real-estate growth encroaching on crocodile habitats
Reports of high heat and humidity
Criticism regarding American expatriates and vacation home building

quotes.text: Puerto Vallarta, Mexico — The salt air of Bahía de Banderas carries the history of pirates and explorers as you walk the coastline where the Pacific meets the Sierra Madre Occidental.

My latest for Cool Material delves into the art and culture side of Puerto Vallarta. I promise you it's worth pulling yourself away from the beach to take in the Jalisco town's gallery scene, incredible street art, and live mariachi music. coolmaterial.com/partner/puer...

A captured crocodile during an operation by authorities and a team of biologists. Large-scale real-estate growth in the tourist city has encroached on crocodiles’ natural habitat, causing more encounters with tourists and local people www.theguardian.com/news/gallery...
